seo_og_changelog_subtitle: Subtitle of the changelog page share image.
seo_og_docs_subtitle: Subtitle of a docs page share image when the page has no description of its own (always, for a Portuguese page).
seo_og_download_subtitle: Subtitle of the download page share image. {platforms} is the list of operating systems formatted for the language (macOS, Windows and Linux).
seo_og_footer: Small line at the bottom right of every share image.
seo_og_home_subtitle: Subtitle of the home page share image (Open Graph), under the headline. One line, about 70 characters.
seo_og_privacy_subtitle: Subtitle of the privacy policy share image.
seo_og_signing_subtitle: Subtitle of the code signing policy share image.
